nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values: Load a clean photo of the real product (test photo: inputs/product.png, an unbranded jar). Only markings that are really on the product may appear in the result. Never use a product designed to look like a famous brand.

nodes.title: Instruction 1
widgets_values: Create a world-class premium commercial product photograph of the product from the reference image. Preserve the exact visible geometry, proportions, materials, color, functional components, and distinctive physical characteristics of the product. Present the product as the central hero object. Sophisticated futuristic studio, deep midnight-blue environment, elegant cobalt-blue rim lighting, volumetric light beams, subtle haze. Polished commercial photography, physically plausible reflections and shadows, strong visual hierarchy, premium material realism, generous clean negative space for future marketing typography. Do not invent new product features, logos, trademarks or branding.
